annotations.text:
IT OPENS AS THE REAL PAGE.

Direction D, built out. Roughly a third the length of the last one, one visual device instead of six, and a nav that actually works - every item scrolls to its section, and there is a back-to-top in the footer.

The career section is nine chips. Click a year and the card swaps with a soft fade. That replaces nine full-screen panels.

Motion: nothing fires on scroll. The colour blobs drift slowly on their own, cards lift on hover, arrows nudge, the nav underline draws in, and the year card animates when you change it.

STILL OPEN

1. You ticked "something else" on the UX question and I never saw what it was. Tell me and I'll fix it.

2. Dates: Express Scripts across 2018-19, Bank of America 2020. Only Sept 2018 and July 2021 are pinned by your record.

3. Your email, and the photo at img/kushal.jpg (3:4).

No phone layout yet - I wanted the desktop right first.
